description: This file defines interfaces and classes for creating and managing grain contexts within the Orleans Runtime framework. It includes the central class 'GrainContextActivator' that handles the creation and configuration of grain contexts, along with related provider interfaces, configurators, and predicates for grain interleaving properties.

classes.name: GrainContextActivator
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating and configuring grain contexts based on grain types and addresses.

classes.name: GrainTypeSharedContextResolver
classes.description: Resolves and caches shared components for each grain type.

classes.name: ReentrantSharedComponentsConfigurator
classes.description: Configures shared components related to reentrancy property for grains.

classes.name: MayInterleaveConfiguratorProvider
classes.description: Provides configurators for grains with MayInterleave attribute, determining interleaving predicates.

classes.name: GrainCanInterleave
classes.description: Holds predicates that determine if grains can interleave message processing.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new grain context for a given grain address.

methods.name: CreateActivator
methods.description: Internal method for creating and caching grain context activators based on grain type.

methods.name: GetComponents
methods.description: Retrieves shared components for a specific grain type.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures shared components for a grain type based on properties.
